note: Fitted on the corpora named in Windows 95-106. Pitch model: P(next pitch) ~ N(pitch; song mean, R) x N(pitch; last pitch, P) x K[(pitch - tonic) mod 12], normalised over +-26 semitones of the song's mean; surprise = mean -log2 per note. Rhythm table: rows = onset position in the bar in twelfths of a quarter beat, columns = distance to the next onset in twelfths (1..96); surprise = mean -log2 P(distance | position).
